name: Spotify Search TV Mode
description: Enlarges search results and genre cards for easier TV browsing

params.css: [data-testid='search-input'] { font-size: 24px !important; padding: 16px 20px !important; height: 56px !important; border-radius: 28px !important; } [data-testid='search-genre-card'], [class*='GenreCard'] { min-height: 140px !important; border-radius: 12px !important; } [data-testid='search-genre-card'] span, [class*='GenreCard'] span { font-size: 20px !important; font-weight: 700 !important; } [data-testid='top-result-card'] { min-height: 200px !important; } [data-testid='top-result-card'] span { font-size: 22px !important; } [class*='SearchResults'] [data-testid='tracklist-row'] { min-height: 60px !important; } [class*='SearchResults'] [data-testid='tracklist-row'] span { font-size: 17px !important; }
